summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass). Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid and invalid cases, plus a non-node input test. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (42 tests) under the prepared venv. Nothing is committed. Not verified: black, isort, ruff, and mypy were unavailable in the shared venv, so formatting and type checks were checked by hand only (all lines are under 88 characters).
